**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 66.06%

**Overview:**  
Indah Bestari Hotel Sdn. Bhd. operates a boutique hotel in the Klang Valley, Selangor. The private limited company was incorporated on 8 July 2018 and is owned by three directors, with a single shareholder controlling 66.06% of the equity. Its issued share capital is RM 250,000. Recent financial snapshots show revenues of RM 35,825,185, RM 37,035,760 and RM 38,796,380, with corresponding equity of RM 29,516,758, RM 31,214,649 and RM 32,955,231. The firm has been involved in two legal cases, none as a defendant.
